concerns.text: The search query state is bound directly to the input field and triggers a backend API reload on every keystroke via the reactive Svelte $effect block. Debouncing the search query is recommended to avoid unnecessary server load.

The document card element has a hardcoded height of 56 (h-56). If the text content is extremely long or if a user has customized font sizes/zoom, it might cause text overflow or truncation. Using min-height or flexible heights is recommended.
Document size is calculated dynamically on the frontend using a string hashing function over the doc ID. In production, document size metadata should be populated directly from the backend database.
